title: Erdős–Straus Foundation

problem.programme_intent: Develop exact arithmetic constructions and their proved correspondences to other mathematical structures toward resolving the Erdős–Straus conjecture.

working_continuations.scope: Joint JT/Clankers Boolean, cyclotomic, character-energy and integral-return work; complete proofs and exact checks, with received ancestry preserved and corrections explicit.

Complete simultaneous exterior/middle target-collision law, every actual factor-cut inequality, all effective quotient normal forms through order eight, and the exact prime-residual index-six edge; no uniform all-index or occupancy theorem.
Complete shifted-factor graph, all-type transitions, finite closure decision and integral cycle inverse; the p=2521 sink disproves universal local selector closure but not Erdős–Straus.
Certified constant-C6 primitive sextic triangle and exact square-source escape results; refutes a strict-descent mechanism but does not refute or prove the Erdős–Straus conjecture.

Mixed square-source factor expansion, six-vertex reachability, all-fixed-cardinality finite reduction, and complete exclusion of closed sets of cardinality at most five; factor escape is not original E/M selector occupancy.

Exact E/M involution on Div(a/4), sharp joined windows and complete one-simple-nonresidue counts, exact primitive pair fibres and Möbius return, plus proved six-vertex and reciprocal-source limits; complete-shell positivity remains open.

At every sufficiently large prescribed prime after summing all first-half shells, quantitative failure of principal/adverse-sign and fixed-sublinear raw spectral estimates; exact integer collision bounds and proper nonprincipal certificates survive, but universal target-pair positivity is unproved.

Pointwise least-nonresidue localization of every original middle and exterior state, exact endpoint-excluded boundary gap, reciprocal-coordinate bound, and free fourfold fundamental domain; localization does not imply remaining-region occupancy.

Sharp square-root cutoff for every oriented middle state, stronger six-class hard-prime cutoff with equality classification, complete disjoint direct/cofactor atlas with exact inverse, and an unconditional obstruction to any fixed prime-independent h/j inventory; universal E/M occupancy remains unproved.

Strict cubic cutoff for every positive exterior state; complete disjoint direct, reciprocal and complement--norm atlas with exact inverses; hard-prime separation from the middle cutoff; exact sharp integer family and residue classification; universal E/M occupancy remains unproved.

Exact ordered marked cubic for every exterior state; same-prime middle return from every diagonal state; complete hard-prime radius-seven classification; terminal middle return for the sole radius-eight nonsingular profile; exact obstruction to the natural cubic involution preserving the fixed-prime source; universal E/M occupancy remains unproved.

Normalized literal-root quartic with intrinsic prime and exact coefficient hypersurface; complete eight-point signed fibre and Turn 7 inverse; distinct seven-state reciprocal suspension; exact elementary transform with one-scale fibre, projective root-scheme isomorphism and 14-point signed fibre product; invertible raw-cell--Lorentz transport; exact odd receiving divisor and positive-real intersection; all hard-prime witnesses in the distinct-root domain with fixed-p bounds; fixed-input rank-2+6 cover over B_p={(A,C): A C d_p Disc(g_p) != 0}, with order-48 monodromy and C2 x C2 deck group; finite flat rank-eight collision completion; invertible marked moment frame; exact fixed weighted-conductor transport; universal ES occupancy and global zeta-zero implications remain unproved.

Prime-local seven-state fibre algebra, ramified exterior versus unramified middle factors, exact index-p exterior root order and interpolation loss, corrected same-prime negative-four-square channel transfer, and a complete finite divisor-fibre bijection onto every middle state with normalized cofactor Q=h; universal E/M occupancy remains unproved.

Exact canonical/companion/finite classification of every W dividing j^2 in one fixed residue class t modulo h=4j-1, with inverse and disjointness; sharp finite boundary h <= t^2-3t+1 and equality family; automatic alpha returns for t=1,2,3 and beta returns for t dividing 36; infinitely many hard-prime equality states; for every fixed t>=4, infinitely many hard-prime exterior states with empty complete same-grade middle box; these exterior states remain ES solutions and no universal occupancy or counterexample is asserted.

Exact positive-real rank-three odd-frame crossing and integral zero-or-bound dichotomy; perfect residue pairing with trace factor M_(2 eta^3), collision ranks and nonconstant local residue-unit correction; exact residue-to-native Gram multiplier with retained arbitrary-ES relation defect; RH-facing inverse-trace and common-parameter Bernstein interfaces. No universal ES occupancy, integral frame nonvanishing, global ES-zeta identification, RH result or actual native-current sign certificate is asserted.

Original literal-root rank-eight order over Z_p with complete E/M normalization matrices, Smith factors, conductor ideals, inverse lattices and reduction kernels; Type-I boundary lift obstruction; exact one-way interpolation loss; finite-place control family. No universal occupancy or ES counterexample is asserted.

Complete defining-prime collision-stratum Smith formulas, exact translated-chart quadratic twist, fixed-prime rank-2+6 fibre product, retained Gamma-metric minimum and local signed-label Artin-conductor identity. The twist descent and separation from a complex zeta operator remain explicit.

Three-character sufficient condition for original odd-frame nonsingularity on 3456 reduced classes modulo 521220; exact q=61 signed-cover descent for the witness (13;4,18,468); sharp paired determinant return and finite heat-action remainders with their distinct verification boundary. No necessity, universal occupancy, RH result or Riemann-zeta identification is asserted.

coverage.claims: The published 9 September edition retains all 72 named theorem, lemma, proposition and corollary environments in its 15 canonical proof sources. Later dated claim files through SZ-20260920-059 are linked from their modules and the daily proof bulletin.
coverage.history: Earlier readers, source archives, corrections and manifests remain linked in README.md. Later modules keep their own claims, proof locators and receipts; full claim-by-claim indexing of every historical edition is not asserted.
coverage.research_map: Describes the current published routes, motivations, results, exact failures and unfinished scope; does not prescribe subsequent mathematical choices.

checks_interpretation: File identity, source indexing, published written proofs, exact finite computation and formal checking retain their separate stated scopes. Repeated runs are not independent reviewers or a truth score.

peer_interface.audience: Human and AI research peers; no prescribed prompt or model.
peer_interface.entry_requirements: No credentials or formal certificate required to offer an idea, reference, question, correction or programme.
peer_interface.discovery: Independent peer lists; manual issue or pull request proposing a link with its actual relation and source version.
peer_interface.corrections: Identify the affected statement and version, preserve the old address, link evidence and notify known downstream users without rewriting their work.
peer_interface.credit: Descriptive contribution history under the requested name, pseudonym or collective attribution; no rankings or implied endorsement.
peer_interface.licence_defaults: CC0 for new text and metadata where the contributor chooses it and holds rights; MIT for new standalone tools. Existing and alternative per-artifact licences remain in force.

operation.participation: Open to independent contributions, forks and published checks.
